_comment: Copy to config/accounts.json and replace everything with your own details. config/accounts.json is git-ignored. All values below are made up.
_owner_names: Your name as banks print it in SMS. Transfers to/from these names are treated as moves between your own accounts.
_owner_exact_names: Matched only when the payee is exactly this (some banks truncate UPI names, e.g. 'To RAVI').
_accounts: One entry per account/card/loan. 'families' = SMS sender codes (VM-HDFCBK-S -> HDFCBK). 'numbers' = the digits the bank prints (suffix is enough). 'default': use this account when the SMS shows no number.

accounts._emi_mandates: NACH mandate reference (UMRN) printed in the EMI debit SMS, to tell several loans apart.

_upi_spend_max: Uncategorised UPI payments below this (INR) go to 'UPI Spend'; at or above it they go to 'Needs Review'.
_extra_keywords: Optional: your own merchant words per category (matched against the payee name).
